IdentityErrors.network_error: Hatukuweza kuunganisha na TEED. Angalia muunganisho wako kisha ujaribu tena.
IdentityErrors.invalid_server_response: TEED imepokea jibu lisilo sahihi kutoka kwa seva. Tafadhali jaribu tena.
IdentityErrors.validation_error: Kagua taarifa zilizoonyeshwa kisha ujaribu tena.
IdentityErrors.invalid_credentials: Barua pepe au nenosiri si sahihi.
IdentityErrors.email_already_registered: Akaunti tayari inatumia barua pepe hii. Ingia au badilisha nenosiri.
IdentityErrors.email_verification_required: Thibitisha barua pepe yako kabla ya kuingia.
IdentityErrors.email_verification_code_invalid: Nambari ya uthibitishaji si sahihi. Ikague kisha ujaribu tena.
IdentityErrors.email_verification_code_expired: Nambari ya uthibitishaji imekwisha muda. Omba nambari mpya.
IdentityErrors.email_verification_attempt_limit_reached: Majaribio mengi yasiyo sahihi yamefanyika. Omba nambari mpya ya uthibitishaji.
IdentityErrors.identity_verification_required: Thibitisha utambulisho wako kabla ya kuendelea.
IdentityErrors.username_already_taken: Jina hilo la mtumiaji tayari linatumika. Chagua jina jingine.
IdentityErrors.phone_number_already_registered: Nambari hiyo ya simu tayari imeunganishwa na akaunti.
IdentityErrors.onboarding_already_completed: Usanidi wa wasifu wako tayari umekamilika.
IdentityErrors.not_authenticated: Kipindi chako kimeisha. Ingia ili kuendelea.
IdentityErrors.session_invalid: Kipindi chako si halali tena. Ingia upya.
IdentityErrors.session_expired: Muda wa kipindi chako umeisha. Ingia upya.
IdentityErrors.refresh_token_invalid: Kipindi chako hakikuweza kurejeshwa. Ingia upya.
IdentityErrors.refresh_token_reuse_detected: TEED imegundua kipindi kisicho salama. Ingia upya ili kulinda akaunti yako.
IdentityErrors.internal_server_error: TEED imepata tatizo lisilotarajiwa. Tafadhali jaribu tena.
